metadata.name: Codex Link
metadata.description: Control Codex with AI Board 01: approvals, status and conversations

metadataV2.tagline: Turn AI Board 01 into a Codex control surface for approvals, sessions, and Skills
metadataV2.longDescription: Use the keyboard knob and toggle to control a Codex agent: approve its actions, check session status and thinking progress, and switch work modes. A local Codex app-server must be running to connect. This plugin consumes the agent protocol and does not perform inference itself.
metadataV2.capability1Detail: The three toggle positions are configured through shared keyboard mappings; this plugin does not redefine them
metadataV2.capability2Detail: Read and write access to the local Codex app-server process (agent.codex@1); clicking “Choose folder…” opens the system picker for a working directory (system.folder-pick@1)
metadataV2.caption0: Connection status: pending approvals at a glance
metadataV2.caption1: Session list: see which thread is thinking
metadataV2.caption2: Skills list: inspect the available Codex capabilities
metadataV2.commitment0: Turn a Skill into an Action-layer shortcut: add it and press the Action key to use it
metadataV2.commitment1: Create a conversation quickly: use the toggle to start a new task in one step
metadataV2.commitment2: Interaction reminders: when a Codex conversation needs you, open the Tab layer and press once to handle it
